definition: In mathematical optimization, affine scaling is an algorithm for solving linear programming problems.
details: Specifically, it is an interior point method, discovered by Soviet mathematician I. I. Dikin in 1967 and reinvented in the U.S. in the mid-1980s.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down.
